key_risks.explanation: Image verification status and exact-model verification are not evidence of actual permission for public commercial reuse; both license_name and license_url are empty on 24 published images. No determination of infringement from these fields alone.
One of 25 total offers dates to 2026-09-28; 24 of 25 have last_checked_at within 24h. Investigate stale offer refresh targeting before treating every stored offer as current.
Four Step5-8 candidates remain research-only, not independently verified or owner-authorized.

remediation_plan: Audit exact holder/rights proof for 24 published images and either record genuine licenses or replace images through a separately approved neutral-icon rollout
Do not download or attach additional vendor images without grant
Record review signatures and URLs for each required field of the first four new products
Check remaining stale merchant offer and decide whether to re-include in refresh targets; do not extrapolate its stock
Request owner approval for generic neutral-icon media policy; not approval to publish any product
Stage validation changes in isolated QA, run complete database negative tests, then propose guarded production cutover
data_coverage_note: Any verified enum describes database workflow state and does not by itself prove independent factual or photo-rights verification.
